# OrderPad (prototype)
Replaces the 6:30am phone-order routine for small restaurants.
- Set par levels per item and supplier once.
- Enter counts each morning; OrderPad writes one order text per supplier.
Status: prototype, CLI only. Next: pilot at parents' restaurant, then SMS/email send.
